rationale: C23 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting framework for the child. It presents four major components of a national scientific effort—basic research, international research cooperation, research facilities and tools, and training scientific manpower—that reappear as major, separately developed components of the oceanography program. Several formulations are also unusually close. C09 provides a broader administrative framework involving interagency coordination, research needs, facilities, manpower, long-range planning, and international cooperation, but it is less closely reflected in the child's organization and wording. C06 resembles only the child's international-cooperation discussion.

shared_material.child_excerpt: 3. Basic and Applied Research. The conduct of research is the central purpose of our whole national effort in oceanography. ... Basic research is the cornerstone on which the successful use of the seas must rest.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your organization has given outstanding support to works of basic research, the hard core of our national effort in science.
shared_material.explanation: Both characterize basic research as the central or foundational core of a national scientific effort.

shared_material.child_excerpt: 2. Shore Facilities and Data Center. ... laboratories and wharfside facilities ... The new National Oceanographic Data Center ... will make available to the scientific community oceanographic data collected throughout the world.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The NSF has also provided important assistance in providing research facilities and research tools, which, in many cases, have become too expensive to be financed by local institutions.
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C23's facilities-and-tools component into a specific oceanographic infrastructure and data program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: 4. Training of Oceanographers. The most important part of our long-range program in oceanography is the training of young scientists. Scientific manpower of every sort will be needed.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Through fellowships, training institutes, and other programs, NSF has made dramatic contributions to the training of scientific manpower in the United States.
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive phrase “training of scientific manpower,” together with fellowships and institutional support, is materially reused and expanded.

shared_material.child_excerpt: 6. International Cooperation. Oceanography is a natural area of opportunity for extensive international cooperation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Equally important has been the international research program. Your work during the International Geophysical Year has established beyond question the universality of science.
shared_material.explanation: International scientific research is treated as another coequal component in the same overall sequence of research, facilities, training, and cooperation.
